gaps.sentence: The road ___ at the moment — use the bypass.
gaps.explanation: 'At the moment' — present continuous passive: is being repaired.

gaps.sentence: The markings ___ (see) with the naked eye.
gaps.explanation: Modal passive: cannot be + seen. The context (astronomy) implies impossibility.

gaps.sentence: Overnight the empty field ___ (TRANSFORM) into a car park.
gaps.explanation: A single completed change in the past: was transformed.

gaps.sentence: I must get my passport ___ (renew) before the trip.
gaps.explanation: 'Get + object + past participle': the passport is renewed by an authority, not by me.

gaps.sentence: The village ___ (reach) by road until 1962; only mules could make the climb.
gaps.explanation: 'Until 1962' describes a past state of affairs: could not be + past participle.

gaps.sentence: The new policy ___ (CRITICISE) sharply since it was announced.
gaps.explanation: 'Since' + continuing result: present perfect passive has been criticised.

gaps.sentence: The stage was still wet — the scenery ___ (paint) only hours before.
gaps.explanation: 'Only hours before' points to the past perfect passive: had been + painted.

gaps.sentence: The results ___ (publish) on the university website next Friday.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + past participle. 'Next Friday' fixes the future reference.
